description: At GK Tours, we believe travel is more than reaching a destination. It is about the experiences, traditions and meaningful moments that stay with us long after the journey ends.

pillars.title: Sacred Lineage
pillars.text: Deeply rooted in the divine traditions of Lord Dattatreya across Gujarat and Maharashtra.

pillars.title: Attentive Hospitality
pillars.text: Thoughtful itineraries tailored for clarity, peace of mind, and physical comfort.

pillars.title: Timeless Reverence
pillars.text: Giving yatris the time, space, and quiet dignity needed for genuine inner connection.
